request: Money out in loans at the top, a card for each borrower, and due dates for each loan. Please share the list with my boss so the office can see the same balances on their own phones.
program:
app "Money lent" wallet plum
table borrower name text
table loan_entry borrower ref borrower, amount money, kind pick Lent|Returned, due date?
"Out in loans" sum(loan_entry.amount where kind = Lent) - sum(loan_entry.amount where kind = Returned) big
each borrower as p
  let bal = sum(p.loan_entry.amount where kind = Lent) - sum(p.loan_entry.amount where kind = Returned)
  stack card tap edit p
    row
      p.name bold grow
      if(bal >= 0, "owes you", "you owe") abs(bal) color if(bal >= 0, good, bad)
form borrower, "Add borrower"
form loan_entry, "Add entry"
list loan_entry by day

request: A count of calls to mom with a circle drawing and a target of 3 a day, plus a 7 day bar chart. My sister should see the same count of calls on her own phone so we both know who's called.
program:
app "Calls to mom" phone ocean
table call
setting target num = 3
let n = count(call today)
draw width 240 tap add call
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * clamp(n / target, 0, 1) stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n big
  label 50, 64, "of" target faint
daybars last 7 days, count(call on it)
when n = target notify "Target reached"
remind "Time for calls to mom" every 3h from 8:00 to 20:00

request: Business spending this month, a last month comparison, and a 7 day bar chart, plus a printed report I can take to the bank each month.
program:
app "Business costs" bag plum
table cost what text, amount money
let spent = sum(cost.amount month)
screen main "Spend" wallet
  "Spent" spent big
  "Last month" sum(cost.amount prev month) faint
  form cost
screen charts "Charts" chart
  daybars last 7 days, sum(cost.amount on it)
  list cost month by day
remind "Add today's expenses" at 22:00

request: late count for the team, say it out loud
program:
app "Late arrivals" clock ink
table late
setting target num = 10 "Count to"
let n = count(late today)
draw width 240 tap add late
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * (n % target) / target stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n % target big
  label 50, 64, "Round" floor(n / target) + 1 faint
button "Reset today" tap remove all late today
button "Undo" tap remove last(late today)
remind "Time for late arrivals" at 8:00, 20:00
